_note: C6 joints and fasteners: local specification values (hardware dimensions from the ISO standards, torques and rules chosen by C6). Read by team/C6/joints.py as P:joints.*. Shared numbers come from params/params.json and the subsystem params; loads come from C1 claims. Frame and units: params.json#frame, SI.

m3_d_m.note: every bought structural fastener is M3 (one thread, one 2.5 mm hex key)

nyloc_protrusion_min_threads.note: bolt end at least 2 pitches past the nyloc nut

insert_len_m.source: Ruthex RX-M3x5.7 / CNC Kitchen M3 standard insert
insert_len_m.note: hole 4.0 mm, blind depth >= engagement + 0.5 mm, boss wall >= 1.6 mm

insert_engage_min_d.note: x d into a heat-set insert; 1.0 d into metal; 2.0 d self-tapping into plastic

fc_screw_len_m.note: FC (and PDB if a PCB) on 4 M3 heat-set inserts; M3x8 is too short through a grommet stack

fc_stack_m.note: nylon washer 0.8 + grommet flange 1.0 + PCB 1.6 + grommet flange 1.0; F3 measures the chosen board

motor_screw_nm.note: M3 into the aluminium motor base, head on a printed plate, no washer; 5 N on a luggage scale at 50 mm from the screw axis

insert_nm.note: M3 into a brass heat-set insert in PETG; insert torque-out is several times higher

printed_max_nm.note: ceiling for any M3 whose head or nut bears on a printed part

strip_bonded_faces_now.source: subsystems/fins (E-FIN-29..36): strip outer face on the PETG slot wall, inner face on the board paper

strip_bonded_faces_prop.source: C6 proposal CR-C6-01: solid PETG tongue between the strips in the collar tail

pin_d_m.source: C6 proposal CR-C6-02: pultruded CF rod 2 mm
